objective_convention: Q = certified_cost = gross_operational_cost, contracted interface settlement EXCLUDED (Addendum 83 ruling 2); salvage reported separately; net = gross - terminal salvage. F = I(x) + Q(x) with I(x) from the pinned W2 table (p515_s47_phase_b_record.OBJECTIVE_CONVENTION; salvage excluded from F, Addendum 27 item 3); F(0) = Q(0).

definitions.margin: m = value(neighbour) - value(x0_A_1x); m < 0: the neighbour is cheaper
definitions.dQ: Q(n) - Q(x0), Q = gross_operational_cost settlement-excluded (as ordered)
definitions.dF: F(n) - F(x0) = dQ + I(n) - I(x0), I from the pinned W2 table via p515_s47_phase_b_record.Lattice
definitions.T_v6bar: settling_criterion_v6.determinacy_threshold(bar_n, bar_x0) = max(3 * max(bar_n, bar_x0), 2 * TAU), TAU = 4539.0682750000005; b read as the screen bar (no band at production exit)
definitions.T_frozen: p515_s47_phase_b_record.resolution(bar_n, bar_x0, sigma_Q) = max(bar_n + bar_x0, sigma_Q), sigma_Q = 18449.663947025518 (the comparator frozen in every screen cell spec)
definitions.T_band: max(3 * larger band width, 2 TAU): not computable at production exit
definitions.bar: the record bar: max over the last 10 cycles of |gross[k] - gross[k-1]|
definitions.verdict_v6: settling_criterion_v6.determinate_certified: |m| >= T -> sign verdict, else within resolution
definitions.verdict_frozen: |m| > T -> sign verdict, else within resolution; PB.classify(F(x0), F(n), T) beside it
definitions.stopping_ratio: rule_ten.terminal_step_over_threshold = |dQ| at the last cycle / production objective tolerance (1e-4 of Q)
definitions.P3: clause 1: no neighbour with verdict "neighbour better"; clause 2: at least one "within resolution"
definitions.unit_neighbour: the stage spec phase_text and Addendum 85 ruling 4 (vii): "the 14 admissible unit neighbours of x = 0 under N"; plan 5.3: "the smallest unit at any non-empty subset of the three nodes, 2025 or 2030"
